find_files_recursive: recursively find all URDF files under a directory using the find_files function with a file_endswith discriminator
file_endswith_check: check whether a given filepath ends with a specific string suffix using the file_endswith utility function
create_AvatarSwitcher: create an AvatarSwitcher instance by passing an AppService and GuiHumanoidController to initialize humanoid model discovery
get_humanoid_models: get a list of humanoid URDF and motion data file pairs from a directory using AvatarSwitcher._get_humanoid_models
switch_avatar_model: switch the active humanoid avatar to the next available model while preserving position, rotation, and grasp state
